title: Holding Agents Accountable with Verifiable Agent Insurance
abstract: arXiv:2610.18230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While AI agents are useful for many tasks, they regularly misbehave in destructive ways, such as deleting important data. While prior work has focused on preventing such misbehavior, we consider how to recover after an agent misbehaves. We propose verifiable agent insurance (VAI), a framework for agent providers to commit financially to promises, a list of programmatically-specified policies that an agent is meant to follow. These promises are embedded in a smart contract on an immutable ledger (e.g., a blockchain) to prevent tampering, along with a monetary escrow. A user who detects a violation of committed promises can prompt a verifier to review agent execution traces, which are logged through the agent harness's shared tool-execution path, without instrumenting each tool separately. translated_title: 通过可验证的智能体保险追究智能体的责任
translated_abstract: 尽管AI智能体在许多任务中很有用，但它们经常以破坏性的方式出现不当行为，例如删除重要数据。先前的工作主要侧重于预防此类不当行为，而我们则考虑在智能体出现不当行为之后如何进行恢复。我们提出了可验证智能体保险（Verifiable Agent Insurance，VAI），这是一个让智能体提供者以经济方式承诺“承诺”的框架，其中“承诺”是一组以程序化方式规定的、智能体应当遵循的策略。这些承诺连同资金托管一起被嵌入到不可篡改账本（如区块链）上的智能合约中，以防止篡改。检测到承诺被违反的用户可以让验证者审查智能体的执行轨迹，这些轨迹通过智能体框架的共享工具执行路径进行记录，无需对每个工具单独进行插桩。在验证违规行为成立后，智能体提供者的托管资金将支付给举报该违规行为的用户。我们将VAI实现为一个端到端的完整实例。
tldr: 提出可验证智能体保险（VAI）框架，将智能体提供者对预设策略的经济承诺写入区块链智能合约并设置资金托管，用户可通过验证智能体执行轨迹来确认违规并获得赔付，从而在智能体出错后实现追责与补偿。
en_tdlr: We propose Verifiable Agent Insurance (VAI), a framework that embeds agent providers' financial commitments to programmatically-specified policies in smart contracts with monetary escrow on an immutable ledger, enabling users to verify violations from agent execution traces and receive compensation.
